I couldn't confirm the Thornbury Cloth Co. deadline of 23 May from anything you can see. There are no Thornbury files in the share I can open for you. Thornbury also doesn't come up anywhere in #central-team or the two Central team digests, so I have no deadline on record to check it against.

The date itself looks off. Today is 14 Oct 2026, so if they meant 23 May this year, it has already passed. They may have meant 23 May 2027, or it could be a mix-up.

I'm treating it as unverified and haven't recorded the date anywhere. The quickest way to settle it is to ask your Thornbury contact in writing, or have the account owner check the order form itself.

I've posted this as a reply under your message in #central-team.
